target: AArch64 native ZealC under UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tictactoe-current-55719.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-tictactoe-win
checks: TicTacToe drew its board, accepted mouse turns, completed a five-move win, and reset/replayed the board.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal; 40+2 returned 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Automated QEMU evidence for the win/replay workflow on this exact ISO. Draw behavior and visible live UTM/Pi interaction are not covered by this run.
